comment: Exact build toolchain of the Windows program (docs/STAGE368_BUILD_LOCK.md). Checked by tools/build_toolchain.py and tests/test_build_lock.py. Python packages: requirements.txt (bundled) and requirements-dev.txt (build and test tools). OCR engine: packaging/windows_ocr_runtime.lock.json.

python.embedded_source: CPython 3.12.16 standalone build 20261026 of flet-dev/python-build release 20261027, chosen by flet-cli 1.1.2 and serious_python 6.1.3
python.host_note: Host Pythons run the tests and flet build; the program runs the embedded one. 3.12.10 is the newest 3.12 that actions/setup-python offers for Windows.

validated_runners.note: GitHub updates runner images weekly; the image, Visual Studio and the Windows SDK are recorded in each build identity, not pinned.
